_doc: WW-geluiden (World Warper, F6.24). Sleutel = sfx-id uit audio_manifest.json. prompt = Engels voor Stable Audio Open; seconds = lengte om te genereren; max_s = lengte na trimmen (tools/check_algemene_sfx.py eist <= 0.60 s). Per geluid 3 kandidaten (andere seeds); Dennis kiest er een, die wordt _01.
_style: 16-bit era JRPG sound effect, biomechanical magic machine, clean, dry, no music, short reverb only
_negative: music, melody, song, speech, voice, long reverb tail, crowd, noise floor, harsh distortion, low quality

ww_hum.prompt: soft warm mechanical hum of an ancient magic machine, gentle low drone with a light shimmering overtone

ww_warp.prompt: rising fantasy teleport whoosh with a bright magical sparkle at the end

ww_sapientia_glitch.prompt: short digital glitch, bitcrushed stutter, slightly ominous computer malfunction
